g.text: Read each row left to right, then continue with the row below.
Stop and repair failed preflight checks before applying k0s.
7–9 · Establish recovery access and Pod networking
NotReady is expected before Cilium: custom CNI, kube-proxy disabled.
10 + OPTIONAL SERVICES · prove the core before adding access
Keep the direct recovery kubeconfig. Before sharing, replace wildcard grants
with scoped access and give each user an appropriate Kubernetes role.
